issue: discount_pct entered as a whole percent (5.0, 12.0) next to fractions (0.1)
impact_basis: Revenue if the entered value were applied literally (a 500% or 1200% discount)
handling: Fixed in gold: values above 1 divided by 100

issue: discount_pct blank
impact_basis: Revenue lost if a null discount nulled out the line's revenue
handling: Fixed in gold: blank = no discount

issue: Completed episodes billed to a platform-fee line (FEE-403)
detection: Episode fee_id resolves to fee_type PLATFORM_FEE
impact_basis: Revenue if these episodes were priced at the platform line's rate
handling: Excluded and flagged; not remapped

issue: Fee lines with no program (FEE-390, FEE-490)
impact_basis: Revenue lost if these lines were dropped
handling: Included under an "Unattributed" employer line

issue: Exact duplicate status records
impact_basis: Revenue and completions if each copy of a current COMPLETED record were counted
handling: Fixed in silver: collapsed, copies counted in source_row_count

issue: Account hierarchy: duplicate account (EMP-102), union under its parent (EMP-104), parent that does not exist (EMP-108 -> EMP-150)
detection: parent_account_id differs from account_id; parent not in accounts; trailing space and case in name
impact_basis: Total unchanged; misattributed = revenue that would appear on a separate employer line without the roll-up
detail: EMP-102 -> EMP-101; EMP-104 -> EMP-103; EMP-108 -> EMP-108 (parent missing)
handling: Fixed in gold: rolled up to the ultimate parent; missing parent = own employer
caught_by_test: relationships parent_account_id (silver, warn); no_untrimmed_values (bronze, warn); ut_dim_employers_*

issue: Memos for Q2 months posted after the as-of date
impact_basis: Revenue if memos posted after the as-of date were excluded
handling: Decision: included and flagged

issue: Outlier memo: round amount, out-of-sequence ID, over 5x the median
detection: abs(adjustment_usd) over 5x the median absolute memo
impact_basis: Revenue if the memo were voided
handling: Included as posted; flagged for Finance to confirm

issue: "Credit" memos with a positive amount
impact_basis: Revenue if the sign were flipped to a credit
handling: Included as posted; flagged for Finance to confirm the sign

issue: Surgery dates in MM/DD/YYYY
detection: Value fails an ISO date cast but matches MM/DD/YYYY
impact_basis: Revenue and completions lost if these dates were left unparsed and the episodes dropped
handling: Fixed in silver: parsed month first

issue: Records dated after the 2026-06-30 extract date
detection: record_updated_at after the as-of date (up to 2026-08-16)
impact_basis: Revenue and completions if the latest record in the whole extract were used
detail: 13 status changes, 79 episodes seen only after the as-of date
handling: Excluded from current status; summarized in later_* columns
fix_belongs: Upstream (extract date or timestamps are wrong)

issue: Completions later reversed in the status log
detection: Episode has a COMPLETED record but a later non-completed record on or before the as-of date
impact_basis: Revenue and completions if every COMPLETED record counted, not the current status
handling: Fixed in gold: current status = latest record
fix_belongs: Model (the log is correct by design)

issue: Completed episodes with surgery before their fee line's effective start (FEE-316)
impact_basis: Revenue and completions if these episodes were counted on that line
handling: Excluded and flagged

issue: Completed episodes with no surgery date
impact_basis: Revenue and completions lost if these episodes were excluded
handling: Fixed in gold: reported in invoice_month, flagged in surgery_month_source

issue: invoice_month lags the surgery month
detection: invoice_month differs from the surgery month
impact_basis: Revenue shift if Q2 were reported by invoice month
handling: Not used for reporting: the rule says surgery month

issue: billing_month not in YYYY-MM (MM/YYYY, YYYY-M)
impact_basis: Revenue if these memos were dropped by a strict parse
handling: Fixed in silver: all three formats parsed

issue: Program went live after its fee lines started (Harrow: fee lines 2026-04-01, go-live 2026-05-01)
detection: go_live_date later than the fee line effective_start
impact_basis: Revenue if platform fees started at go-live; pacing effect in detail
detail: FEE-311 pacing 0.58 -> 0.79 if pro-rated from go-live 2026-05-01
handling: Decision: follow the fee window (April platform fee recognized; pacing from the window); flagged

issue: Discount on a platform-fee line (FEE-403); the rule does not say whether discounts apply to platform fees
impact_basis: Revenue if the discount were not applied to platform fees
handling: Decision: discount applied (rule says "fee line")

issue: Memo delivered twice
impact_basis: Revenue if the duplicate were counted twice
handling: Fixed in silver: collapsed

issue: Memo on a program not in Salesforce
impact_basis: Revenue if the memo were dropped
handling: Included under the "Unattributed" employer line

issue: Test records (provider PRV-TEST, member TEST-*) on fee line FEE-999, which is not in the schedule
detection: Provider and member ID patterns; fee_id not in the fee schedule
impact_basis: No revenue effect (no rate); see detail for episode counts
detail: 15 completed test episodes would inflate episode counts; their fee line has no rate
handling: Excluded and flagged
fix_belongs: Upstream (test data in a production extract)

issue: SCHEDULED episodes whose surgery date has passed
detection: Current status SCHEDULED and surgery_date on or before the as-of date
impact_basis: Not quantified: may be unrecorded completions; potential in detail
detail: up to $19392.00 Q2 revenue and 6 completed episodes if these were actually completed; 6 of them are COMPLETED in records after the as-of date
handling: Counted as not completed (as recorded); flagged
